name: AI incidents & governance
value: AI voice fraud charges; Grok legal risk
summary: US charges three over AI-spoofed executives in a $129m fraud; SpaceX discloses possible Virginia action over Grok
state: US prosecutors allege three men used AI to mimic the voices and images of executives and lawyers, stealing about $129m between 2024 and 2026, including from hospitals (The Record, 6 Nov). SpaceX disclosed that Virginia's attorney general is contemplating suing over its statements on Grok generating sexualised deepfake images (MLex, 23 Oct). A ransomware group was reported on 2 Nov to be using AI agents to move through networks (Help Net Security). No AI-enabled attack on critical infrastructure or AI-attributed mass harm had been found as of 8 Nov.
for_you: Finance staff at organisations are the main target of voice and video impersonation. People whose images are used in sexualised deepfakes are the most directly harmed.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant AI misuse incident ($129m alleged AI-spoofing fraud) and regulatory confrontation over Grok. Alert line not met: no AI-enabled attack on critical infrastructure.
